This Writ Petition Coming On For Preliminary

 Order

Petitioners have sought for issuance of writ of certiorari to quash the order dated 28.03.2023 passed in LAC No. 62/2018 by the II Additional District and Sessions NC: 2023:KHC:21222 Judge,
Mandya, and to allow I.A.X filed under Section 152 of CPC.

sentences.text: The facts that are made out is that one Smt. Putta Hombalamma died on 24.11.2014, who had interest with respect to the property which was acquired by the respondents.
After her death, an application came to be filed by petitioner No.1 seeking enhancement of compensation under Section 18(1) of the Land Acquisition Act.

The said application was taken up for consideration and was numbered as LAQ.CR:62/2011-12.
3.

It is submitted that another application came to be filed by the other legal representatives of Smt.
Putta Hombalamma i.e., Naga, Santhosh, Kalavathi and Shruthi, seeking permission to come on record.
The said application came to be allowed on 29.11.2019 by allowing the applicants to come on record.
It is not in dispute that the said application was filed by the above mentioned persons.

Nagaraju vs Executive Engineer, Karnataka on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179262541/
2 NC: 2023:KHC:21222 4.

The grievance of the petitioners is that when the judgment was pronounced in LAC No.62/2018,
in the cause title, name of only Sri. Nagaraju S/o. Puttaboraiah was mentioned, despite the application being allowed by the same Court permitting all the legal representatives of Smt. Putta Hombalamma to come on record.
Accordingly, another application came to be filed under Section 152 of CPC to amend the award.

The said application was rejected without making out any grounds for such rejection nor adverting to the factum of allowing of the earlier application to bring the legal representatives of Smt. Putta Hombalamma on record which was allowed on 29.11.2019.
5.
Accordingly, the order dated 28.03.2023 is set aside and the application - I.A.X filed under Section 152 of CPC is allowed.
In light of allowing of I.A.X, the judgment and award passed in LAC No.62/2018 to be amended by including the names of following parties along with Sri. Nagaraju S/o.

Late Puttaboraiah:
NC: 2023:KHC:21222 a. Sri. Naga S/o.
Late Putta Boraiah b. Sri. Santhosh S/o.
Late Putta Boraiah c. Smt. Kalavathi W/o.
Late Manju d. Smt. Shruthi D/o.
Late Manju
In light of the above, petition is disposed off.

Sd/-
